summary: Viatris filed a routine 8-K reporting third-quarter 2026 results: total revenues of $3.75 billion, a U.S. GAAP net loss of $325 million and adjusted EBITDA of $1.20 billion, with a conference call and webcast hosted the same day. The release notes roughly $717 million of capital returned to shareholders year to date and reiterates the previously announced planned acquisition of Pacira BioSciences, expected to close by end-November 2026, with no new deal terms disclosed. The filing is an earnings/other-events update rather than a standalone special situation; the Pacira transaction and any divestiture progress remain items to watch.
